text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! This is Haiseiko♪ Let's make today 
full of smiles and have a wonderful day!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm, maybe I should ad-lib a bit? 
'Haiseiko moves up alongside from the 
outside! Will Haiseiko awaken first!' 
...No good?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
In that case... "Rawr~, it's the 
'Monster-chan'♪ If you don't wake up soon, 
I'll eat you up... *chomp*!" ...Is that 
going too far, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer...! I'm so sorry, I was 
just so focused~!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Um... the 16th edition of the alarm clock 
featuring my voice is coming out soon. So, 
this is kind of like practice, you could 
say...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just goofing off a little bit. 
Please keep it a secret from everyone, 
okay~?"
